parts.t: What is the difference between freehold condos and Tsawwassen North leasehold condos?
, and Tsawwassen Springs sit on fee-simple freehold land in the City of Delta. Condo buildings in
(north of 28 Avenue) sit on Tsawwassen First Nation treaty land under 99-year prepaid leases, which typically trade at a lower price per square foot than comparable new freehold buildings.
Does the BC Speculation and Vacancy Tax apply to Tsawwassen North condos?

Tsawwassen First Nation treaty lands are exempt from the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax, whereas freehold properties inside the City of Delta fall under standard Metro Vancouver SVT declaration rules.
What are typical monthly strata fees for Tsawwassen condos under $800K?

Monthly strata fees in Tsawwassen apartment buildings typically range from $310 to $580 depending on unit size, building age, elevator count, and whether hot water, gas, or clubhouse facilities are included.
Are there 55+ age-restricted condo buildings in Tsawwassen?

Yes, several established low-rise buildings near 56 Street in Tsawwassen Town Centre maintain 55+ age-restriction bylaws, while Tsawwassen Springs, Tsawwassen North, and many Town Centre buildings are open to all ages. Always verify the registered Strata Bylaws on the Form B.
Can you get a standard mortgage on a 99-year prepaid leasehold condo in Tsawwassen North?

Yes. Because the 99-year ground lease is prepaid up front by the developer, major Canadian banks and credit unions provide conventional residential mortgages on Tsawwassen Shores and Boardwalk strata units.
Are pets and rentals permitted in Tsawwassen condo buildings?

Long-term residential rentals are permitted across non-55+ strata buildings under the BC Strata Property Act (though short-term vacation rentals are commonly prohibited by bylaw and local regulation). Most buildings allow one or two domestic pets.
